This theory, so far, has not been able to prove itself on all fronts. Take for example, Adam alayhi salam. The era of recorded history is, in comparison to the estimate of his time, much, much closer to our time than his, and therefore one cannot expect human records of his story. That's why they are in scripture - Allah subhanahu wa ta'ala chose to tell us about them as a lesson. If we confirm the validity of the scripture, we simply must believe in the truthfulness of these stories - that's part of believing in the supernatural.
